fields.name: id
fields.description: The unique identifier of the review.

fields.name: reservation_id
fields.description: The identifier of the associated reservation.

fields.name: reviewer_type
fields.description: Whether the review was written by a guest or host.

fields.name: rating
fields.description: The overall star rating from 1 to 5.

fields.name: comments
fields.description: The text content of the review.

fields.name: category_ratings
fields.description: Individual category ratings provided by the reviewer.

fields.name: host_response
fields.description: The host response to the review, if provided.

fields.name: created_at
fields.description: The timestamp when the review was submitted.
